name: Weapon Master
summary: +1 Str or Dex; use the mastery property of one Simple or Martial weapon kind, changeable after a Long Rest.

benefits.name: Mastery Property
benefits.summary: Use the mastery property of one proficient Simple or Martial weapon kind; change it on a Long Rest.
benefits.text: You can use the mastery property of one kind of Simple or Martial weapon of your choice, provided you have proficiency with it. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can switch to another eligible kind of weapon.
